calculation_handling.description: Waste and recyclable material storage in a wholly enclosed building, for a place of worship built under a permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013; not a numeric limit and not evaluated from lot data.
calculation_handling.gaps: waste storage and building permit date are not held

units.disclosure: A place of worship built under a building permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013 must store all waste and recyclable material in a wholly enclosed building. This is not evaluated from lot data.

150.50.150.1(1).explanation: Waste and recyclable material must be stored in a wholly enclosed building when a place of worship is built under a permit issued more than three years after May 9, 2013.
